title: A short listening game, about 15 minutes.
subtitle: Headphones on, quiet room.
instructions: Play the Reference: it is the original.
Slide each version toward 100 if it sounds the same as the Reference, lower if it does not.
One version is the original in disguise: give it 100.
listening_advice: Set a comfortable volume on the Reference in the first round and do not change it afterwards.
consent: I understand that this is an anonymous listening test about audio quality. I take part voluntarily and can stop at any time by closing this page. My ratings are stored under a random session number, together with the browser name and screen size.
